zh: DragonClaw 在输入框上方吸附实时待办任务清单，支持一键折叠与划线完成动画。
任务状态与当前会话实时同步，可直观查看完成进度并保持对话视区清爽。
优化工作区面板与任务清单的联动响应，输入与任务管理紧密贴合。
en: DragonClaw docks a live task list right above the composer with collapse and strike-through animations.
Task states update in real-time with the active session, keeping the message viewport tidy.
Refined workspace panel coordination for seamless task tracking while composing prompts.
